parsed.post: Keeping my latest run (1.027676). Increasing depth to 8 and reducing LR to 0.06 performed better than my previous 1.035777. Next, I will test adding WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to see if it stabilizes the learning rate and improves convergence for the depth-8 architecture.
parsed.description: Add WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to the current best configuration (DEPTH=8, MATRIX_LR=0.06) to improve convergence.
